name: io.github.chrischall/myatriumhealth-mcp
description: MyAtriumHealth (Epic MyChart) records via your signed-in browser tab

environmentVariables.name: MAH_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: true refuses mah_reply_message sends (previews still work). Default false.

environmentVariables.name: MAH_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: MyAtriumHealth username. Set with MAH_PASSWORD to enable bridge-less mode. Leave both empty to relay through your signed-in browser tab.

environmentVariables.name: MAH_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Portal password. Both are required; setting only one falls back to the bridge (with a warning).

environmentVariables.name: MAH_DOTENV
environmentVariables.description: Path to a .env file read first; failing that ~/.myatriumhealth-mcp/.env, then ./.env. A real MAH_USERNAME / MAH_PASSWORD in the environment always wins.

environmentVariables.name: MAH_DEVICE_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Session state (0600), default ~/.myatriumhealth-mcp/device.json. Holds the live cookie jar as well as the device token — treat as a credential.

environmentVariables.name: FETCHPROXY_WS_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Bind interface for the fetchproxy concentrator, a literal IP only (default 127.0.0.1). Keep on loopback; it exists for hosted deployments that run each MCP in its own network namespace.

environmentVariables.name: FETCHPROXY_IDENTITY_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path where the fetchproxy long-term identity keypair is stored (default ~/.fetchproxy/identity/).
